description: Figure 5 presents the proportion of incorrectly answered samples where the generated entity popularity (RPop_Ge) is less than the ground truth popularity (RPop_GT). The horizontal axis displays the categories “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball”, listed alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Proportion” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 220, with tick marks at intervals of 20. Three bars are displayed, one for each category. The “Movies” bar is light blue and extends to approximately 180. The “Songs” bar is orange and reaches a height of approximately 140. The “Basketball” bar is green and extends to approximately 100. No bars are visually emphasized, and the bars are arranged in alphabetical order according to the category labels.
